scientific_question: Can site-stratified exact conditional season-by-two-solar-bin testing maintain size under heterogeneous site-specific season rates and phase profiles while a site-pooled Fisher test spuriously rejects?
conditional_sampling_model: For each physically distinct site i and original fixed within-site margins N_i total, K_i early-bin count, D_i falling-branch count, X_i falling-early is hypergeometric under within-site branch-bin OR theta_i=1 and noncentral hypergeometric with common theta under alternative. Independent sites conditional on margins.
repetition: For balanced templates duplicate the same margin per independent physical site. For composition alternately repeat the two fixed types in equal numbers. These are fixed conditional margin thought experiments, not a measured field observation frame.
first_frozen_test: One-sided exact upper tail for T=sum_i X_i; null PMF is convolution of independent within-site CENTRAL hypergeom probabilities. Alternative PMF is exponential tilt of the null by theta^T, equivalent to convolution of site-level Fisher noncentral hypergeom.
unstratified_comparator: Naively collapse all site margins to one pooled 2x2 table and apply central hypergeometric Fisher upper tail to T. Report its ACTUAL conditional rejection probability under the site-specific fixed margins and common theta, never call this calibrated nominal-alpha power under heterogeneous composition.
exact_calculation: No stochastic simulation. Log binomial coefficients via lgamma; per-site null PMFs normalized; convolution with exact support offsets; exponential tilt for theta; all upper-tail thresholds computed at nominal alpha with no mid-p.
frozen_adversarial_observed_table: One early-profile site X=54 and one late-profile site X=2; within each fixed site observed branch-by-bin odds ratio is exactly 1; pool totals and report each p-value, pooled OR and site-conditioned expected T.
hard_checks: All 3 templates × 4 physical-site-counts × 4 truth ORs reported (48 outcomes)
Exact stratified size never above 0.05 at common OR=1 for every configuration
Exact conditional null PMF and alternative PMF normalized and nonnegative
At each conditional margin configuration, exact conditional rejection probability nondecreasing with true common OR
Fixed world has pooled odds ratio >1 but exact within-site odds ratio exactly 1 for both sites
At least one composition-confounded scenario has pooled nominal-alpha null rejection probability >0.05
Explicitly report pooled actual null-rejection probabilities without relabeling as calibrated test size
Under sparse support, no fabricated nondetection and no independence attributed to within-site events
Separate physical-site sampling unit from animal-event count and from two geographic regions
No source animal event, original camera operation log, station GPS or source-response-derived calendar access
Previously frozen parent inference/empirical route untouched
